p: I shall not want: He has care over me and ministers all things to me.
restoreth my soul: He comforts or refreshes me.
paths of righteousness for his name's: Plain or straight ways.
shadow of death: Though he was in danger of death, as the sheep that wanders in the dark valley without his shepherd.
table before me in the presence: Even though his enemies sought to destroy him, yet God delivers him, and deals most liberally with him in spite of them.
anointest my head with oil: As was the manner of great feasts.
house of the LORD for ever: He does not set his happiness in the pleasures of this world, but in the fear and service of God.
